summary: Control-plane heartbeat suppression led to short window of secondary-region egress and p95 latency spike for streaming API
description:
Issue summary:
During a scheduled control-plane maintenance window (rolling config reload) on 2026-03-10 at ~15:12 UTC, a transient suppression of heartbeat announcements from the regional control-plane resulted in a subset of long-lived streaming connections being rerouted to the nearest compatible edge in a different region (APAC/SIN). This produced a short-lived p95 latency spike (~420ms -> ~1.9s) and increased TLS handshake rate as clients re-established streams.

Impact:
- Customer: NexaHealth (enterprise, private VPC) reported increased response times for streaming chat inference and occasional truncated SSE events for 1.7 minutes.
- Observed: p95 for streaming generate API increased in affected pools; a small percentage (~2.1%) of requests egressed via apac-sin instead of us-west-2. No model outputs were persisted outside customer's VPC (control-plane metadata only).

Environment:
- Prod (us-west-2 primary), private deployment with VPC peering to Redwood control plane. Models: gpt-redwood-3b (primary), open-llama-7b (fallback).

Timeline (UTC):
- 2026-03-10 15:11:38: control-plane rolling reload started (config patch rollout).
- 2026-03-10 15:12:05: first heartbeat gap observed in control-plane telemetry (3s gap to edge).
- 2026-03-10 15:12:20: NexaHealth alerted support via #support with complaint of slow streaming responses.
- 2026-03-10 15:13:05: SRE observed edge route failover events for token-scoped residency.
- 2026-03-10 15:14:50: control-plane heartbeats restored; routing normalized by 15:15:10.

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) Simulated rolling control-plane reload with a 2–4s pause in heartbeat publish on a subset of nodes.
2) Replay long-lived client streaming connections (SSE) under the same token-scoped residency settings.
3) Observe edge selection: some tokens are reassigned to nearest available edge in different region when heartbeat gap crosses the residency grace window.

Investigation notes:
- Root cause hypothesis: a race during config reload where the control-plane’s heartbeat publisher thread skipped an announcement due to GC pause + config reload lock, temporarily failing the residency freshness check in edge-proxy. The edge then applied fallback routing logic (nearest compatible region) for active tokens.
- Autoscaling and serving-runtime capacity were healthy; CPU/GPU utilization unchanged.
- No evidence of model data leaving customer VPC; only control-plane routing metadata and edge selection changed.
- Grafana dashboards: dashboards.redwood.internal/d/ingress/residency-routing?from=2026-03-10T15:00Z show the route shift. Traces in Jaeger: trace ID 6f3a2b4e show TLS handshake spikes.

Logs & metrics excerpt (sanitized):
- control-plane heartbeat_gap_max: 3.8s at 2026-03-10T15:12:05Z
- edge-proxy routing_fallback_count: +48 over 90s
- streaming_api_p95_latency_us-west-2: 420ms -> 1.9s (15:12:00–15:14:00)

Temporary mitigation applied:
- 15:16 UTC: Shortened residency grace threshold from 5s -> 8s for control-plane reload windows to avoid immediate fallback (hotfix config). Deployed to control-plane leader group.
- 15:18 UTC: Reapplied normal values after validation and added extra guards to heartbeat publisher lock path.

Resolution / next steps:
- Root cause fix: patch to remove blocking call during heartbeat announcement and introduce jittered heartbeat retries. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4521 (in review).
- Ops follow-up: add an alert when heartbeat_gap > 1s during rolling reloads and create a runbook step to pause rollouts if fallback_count > threshold.
- Product/Support follow-up: notify affected customers with a short post-incident summary and confirm no data residency violations.

Customer communication log:
- 2026-03-10 15:20 UTC: Initial acknowledgement to NexaHealth, informing them we are investigating.
- 2026-03-10 16:00 UTC: Provided high-level root cause and that no model data left their VPC.
- 2026-03-11: Shared PR link and follow-up plan; scheduled a short call for post-incident review.

Attachments (references):
- Slack: #support thread https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C02SUPPORT/p1678530725
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/residency-routing
- Jaeger trace: 6f3a2b4e
